text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa♪ Here's a preee-seee-nt~. 
Rickey-chan, it's your b-day today, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, an ordinary compass... 
but no ordinary compass is this! Enter the 
data and press the button, and it glows in 
seven colors! It even plays 8-bit sounds! 
...Though I haven't charged it yet.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Ah, this is it! Red, yellow, blue, 
green, white, purple, pink! Every single 
one is a lucky color! So thorough~! I'll 
give it a try next time!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(...Seriously? I just brought a gag gift 
for a quick laugh, and she's totally 
thrilled with it.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I'll deliver my gift to your dorm later. 
You often visit Funabashi for your races, 
don't you, Rickey-san? So to help you love 
Funabashi even more—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The "Funabashi Capsule Toy Complete Set." 
Exquisitely detailed figures recreating 
famous landmarks and specialties of 
Funabashi, complete with an acrylic 
Funabashi map display base.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Including the secret ones, there are 51 
types in total. If you complete the set, 
it's no exaggeration to say you're a true 
Funabashi expert.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, fitting it into the acrylic base 
turns it into a 3D tourist map! Amazing! 
With this, you can see all of Funabashi's 
feng shui topography in a glance!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(She took the bait on that local 
promotional merch way harder than I 
expected...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if we determine the day's lucky 
direction with the Seven-Colored Compass, 
and illuminate it from beneath the acrylic 
map...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A complete guide to Funabashi's daily 
lucky spots! If you check out the local 
specialties... at the spots lit up to 
boost your desired fortune—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't this make for the ultimate 
good-luck stroll?! Let's go do that on our 
next day off!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mm. In Ricky-chan's hands, visual gags and 
regional promos alike all become good-luck 
gadgets... You really can't beat her~
